versions.changelog:
Initial release of bark-notify skill.

- Sends Bark (day.app) push notifications when a Codex or Claude task finishes.
- Notifies with device name, project name, status, and a short summary.
- Supports custom project name detection from AGENTS.md or uses folder name.
- Includes a helper script to post notifications to the Bark API.
- Environment variables allow easy configuration for multiple devices.
